evals.prompt: Create a custom table called 'Project' with a primary name column, a priority choice column (Low/Medium/High), and a lookup to Account. Put it in the 'ContosoProjects' solution.
evals.expected_output: Agent creates the table via EntityDefinitions POST with MSCRM.SolutionUniqueName header set to 'ContosoProjects'. Includes @odata.type on all attribute metadata. Creates relationship via RelationshipDefinitions. Calls PublishXml after.
expectations: Every POST to EntityDefinitions includes header MSCRM.SolutionUniqueName: ContosoProjects
Table creation payload includes a StringAttributeMetadata with IsPrimaryName: true
Lookup is created via OneToManyRelationshipMetadata with CascadeConfiguration
PublishXml is called after form/view creation

evals.prompt: Create 3 tables for a project management system: Project, Task, and Milestone. Tasks belong to Projects, Milestones belong to Projects.
evals.expected_output: Agent creates publisher and solution first, then tables in dependency order. Uses MSCRM.SolutionUniqueName header throughout. Creates tables before relationships.
expectations: Publisher is created or verified to exist before solution creation
Solution is created before any table creation
All 3 tables are created before any relationships
Each table has a primary name column (IsPrimaryName: true)
MSCRM.SolutionUniqueName header is present on every creation request
Relationships are created after all referenced tables exist

evals.prompt: I need to authenticate to the Dataverse Web API from my terminal to create some tables.
evals.expected_output: Agent provides Azure CLI authentication method. Does NOT suggest 'pac auth token' (which doesn't exist).
expectations: Specifies --resource parameter with the org URL
On Windows, suggests PowerShell for subsequent Web API calls
